risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included (case-only sale).
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip showing the disc inside the case (or the disc itself) and the back of the case confirming contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only / untested (worst case: no disc).

risks.risk: Disc condition may be poor (scratches/marks) affecting playability.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the disc surface under light (front and back) showing scratches/scuffs.

risks.risk: Game may be a copy/bootleg or otherwise not original.
risks.proof: Photo of the disc label and inner ring text + a screenshot of the game info from the PS4 after installation (or proof of authenticity).

risks.risk: Region/edition mismatch could cause issues (less likely for PS4, but still possible).
risks.proof: Photo of the region/edition markings on the case/back and (if possible) a PS4 “Game Info” screen showing region/serial details.

risks.risk: Case completeness may be incomplete (missing manual/insert).
risks.proof: Photo of everything inside the case (manual/insert) laid out, then placed back in.

proof_requests: Show the disc (front/back) clearly and confirm it is included in the case.
Provide a close-up video of the disc surface under bright light to assess scratches.
Show the back/inside of the case for edition/region markings.
Show what’s inside the case (manual/insert) to confirm completeness.
If possible, provide a PS4 “Game Info” screenshot after installation to confirm it runs.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a PS4 game case for Red Dead Redemption II, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, disc inclusion/condition and authenticity are not verifiable from the photo, so it should be priced conservatively until proof is provided.
